mapper.select: SELECT INBOX_ID, LEASE_EPOCH, PAYLOAD_JSON FROM CHANNEL_INBOUND_INBOX WHERE 1=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHANNEL_INBOUND_INBOX (INBOX_ID, TENANT_ID, SOURCE_NAME, MESSAGE_ID, PAYLOAD_HASH, PAYLOAD_JSON, TRACE_ID, STATUS_CODE, ATTEMPTS, LEASE_EPOCH, LEASE_UNTIL, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{inboxId}, #{tenantId}, #{sourceName}, #{messageId}, #{payloadHash}, #{payloadJson}, #{traceId}, 'PENDING', 0, 0, 0, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT PAYLOAD_HASH FROM CHANNEL_INBOUND_INBOX WHERE INBOX_ID=#{inboxId} AND TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND SOURCE_NAME=#{sourceName}
mapper.update: UPDATE CHANNEL_INBOUND_INBOX SET STATUS_CODE='RUNNING', ATTEMPTS=ATTEMPTS+1, LEASE_OWNER=#{leaseOwner}, LEASE_EPOCH=LEASE_EPOCH+1, LEASE_UNTIL=#{leaseUntil}, UPDATED_AT=#{updatedAt}, ERROR_CODE=NULL WHERE INBOX_ID=#{inboxId} AND TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND LEASE_EPOCH=#{leaseEpoch} AND ((STATUS_CODE='PENDING' AND NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (STATUS_CODE='RUNNING' AND LEASE_UNTIL<=#{leaseUntil2}))

UPDATE CHANNEL_INBOUND_INBOX SET STATUS_CODE=#{statusCode}, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT=#{nextAttemptAt}, UPDATED_AT=#{updatedAt}, ERROR_CODE=#{errorCode}, LEASE_OWNER=NULL, LEASE_UNTIL=0 WHERE INBOX_ID=#{inboxId} AND TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND STATUS_CODE='RUNNING' AND LEASE_OWNER=#{leaseOwner} AND LEASE_EPOCH=#{leaseEpoch} AND LEASE_UNTIL>#{leaseUntil}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CHANNEL_INBOUND_INBOX WHERE TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, INBOX_ID LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE CHANNEL_INBOUND_INBOX SET STATUS_CODE='PENDING', ATTEMPTS=0, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT=#{nextAttemptAt}, UPDATED_AT=#{updatedAt}, ERROR_CODE=NULL WHERE INBOX_ID=#{inboxId} AND TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND STATUS_CODE='DEAD'
mapper.select: SELECT INBOX_ID FROM CHANNEL_INBOUND_INBOX WHERE STATUS_CODE='SUCCEEDED' AND UPDATED_AT<#{updatedAt} ORDER BY UPDATED_AT, INBOX_ID LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CHANNEL_INBOUND_INBOX WHERE INBOX_ID=#{inboxId} AND STATUS_CODE='SUCCEEDED' AND UPDATED_AT<#{updatedAt}
